column1: # BundleDock shared shell shortcuts: one table for bash, zsh, fish and Nushell.
# Format: name<TAB>command. Names use [a-z0-9] only so every shell accepts them.
# Commands are plain words; {branch} is the current Git branch (fails on a
# detached HEAD) and {default} is the default branch (origin/HEAD, else main,
# else master). Extra arguments typed after a shortcut are appended.
# Git names follow jhillyerd/plugin-git (MIT, see licenses/shell-layer). The set
# is curated: no --no-verify, git-svn, git-flow or forge-specific entries and no
